entities.summary: Rhinocorura or Rhinocolura was the name of a region and one or more associated towns and rivers lying between Ancient Egypt and Palestine. The name may refer explicitly to:As Rhinocorura, a desert location on the border between Ancient Egypt and Palestine mentioned by Strabo and Diodorus Siculus. This appears to be the original usage of the name, which means "cut-off noses" in Greek. Diodorus relates that it was founded by the Ethiopian king Actisanes as a place of exile for those found guilty of robbery whom he punished by cutting off their noses.
